title: Pagination
description: Page navigation for long lists, in three button styles. A highlight slides to the page you pick.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The pages and the frame
fragments.note: One frame slides to the page you pick.

fragments.title: Change page
fragments.note: Move aria-current, place the frame, disable the step with nowhere to go.

fragments.title: Place the frame
fragments.note: Measured, so the row can have any number of pages at any width.

fragments.title: The frame's two transitions
fragments.note: The direction decides which edge leaves first.

fragments.title: One arrow icon, flipped for next
fragments.note: Both arrows use the same icon file.

fragments.title: The three button styles
fragments.note: A box, a box with a word, and no box at all. Everything else is shared.
